description: A request_user_dialog of a kind MAWS's initialize did not declare (the binary's own cost_threshold dialog kind): it stays pending and visible, and MAWS never completes or cancels it. Synthetic: no probe fixture produces one.
source: SPEC 45 §45.22.13 (an undeclared kind is never answered by the host); cli.pretty.js:927997 (the kind names beside auto_mode_server_fallback, cost_threshold among them); C3's broker posts notice dialog:undeclared:<requestId>
